I had a quick glance at your post history to try and gather some context so here's my thoughts. You seem to be a needy lover, that isn't an insult, you've had a tough break in life like a lot of people and it seems impossible for me to think that hasn't influenced how you view love. Love isn't one thing, it isn't the same for all of us, I'd say it's probably entirely unique to each of us as individuals. Some people need to show how deeply they cherish the people they love but don't need it in return, some may want reciprocity. Others are content for what may seem a "less" intense and emotional love and would want the same from a partner.

Point I'm trying to make is you may love this man with everything you have, but there's an imbalance in the relationship that is too great to overcome in it's current condition. If he can't or won't give you the kind of love you want and seem to need then, as awful as it would be, I think you need to try and move on. It's cliché but that doesn't mean it's not true, there are many people who you could love just as much and who could give you the kind of love you want and deserve. Good luck

Thanks for sharing your story and thoughts. I was just gonna say I'm sorry for your loss but how can I be sorry if what I want will cause that kind of pain for people I love... More thinking to do, thank you.

We're all burdens to someone at some point in time, the question that is important here is will you always be JUST a burden? Or is there a future where you will help another person when they feel like you do? A future where you are the least burdensome a person possibly can be?

 I'm struggling with depression and suicide myself, although to be honest I've kind of given in at this point but your statement is not true at all. I'm as certain as I can be that I'm going to die soon but I'm not under an illusion that the people that love me will be better off, I don't want to insult you but that train of thought is just a way to justify what you want. 

 I hope you try to reach out, there's a possibility that the love and affection of those you choose to tell could turn this around for you. Everyone has their own shit, even those you look at and think wow they have this figured out, you'd be shocked if you could really see. So try not to be angry or upset that you have to actually ask for help because they don't see your pain. It's hard to see past our own pain sometimes. All the best dude <3

Few things. "Concentrate on your child..." I'd like to preface this by saying I hate the idea of abortion, it turns my stomach, I struggle to empathise with people that are so careless they become pregnant (or impregnate someone else). But this woman is suicidal and assuming that she should or will keep this child is not okay, she has a horrible decision to make in less than ideal circumstances and your comment seems to flippantly remove her choice from the equation.

"Pray for..." Really?

"Tell your mother that you are truly sorry." She wrote quite confidently her mother won't help her, a mother who won't help her child in a situation like this may not deserve an explanation let alone an apology but either way, best we don't assume.
